title: Project documented character modifier examples
changes: Extend the private USA catalog builder with an explicit option for two documented job/race/appearance examples, using dependent domains and preserving the conflicting original notes and provenance.
Exclude the source entry with an unresolved address and leave all other combinations unavailable rather than infer a compatibility table.
validation: Protected validation produced seven character entries alongside the existing eight ability entries, preserved source notes/provenance, excluded CH-0236, refused altered source/table inputs and prevented overwriting. A separate compatibility check confirmed the default ability-only output remains byte-identical.

In a protected isolated USA Wine/Xvfb frontend, an incompatible combination was refused, both documented tuples were explicitly prepared, armed and disarmed, and the first was saved and rearmed from a preset without guest advancement. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg2-20-usa-character-examples-ucw5y1gi/, dbg2-20-ability-projection-compatibility-in29bkzo/, dbg2-20-character-examples-wine-__ltq06k/.
limitations: The two combinations are source examples, not a complete domain or proof of actual game effects or physical-device behavior. CH-0236 remains excluded and conflicting original field notes are preserved.
The Wine test used a Windows GNU executable built before concurrent DBG2-25 changes elsewhere in the shared workspace; native Windows and physical input were not tested.
